title: Update your name, email, photo or password
summary: Manage personal sign-in information separately from the business profile.

sections.title: Update your personal profile
sections.body:
1. Open the account menu and select **Profile & security**.
2. Under **Profile details**, edit **Full name** and **Email address**.
3. Use the photo controls to choose a supported profile image or **Remove photo** if needed.
4. Select **Save changes**.
5. If you changed your email, open the verification message sent to the new address. The previous address also receives a security notice.

sections.title: Change your password
sections.body:
1. In **Change password**, enter **Current password**, **New password** and **Confirm password**.
2. Use a unique password with at least eight characters.
3. Select **Change password** and keep the new password in a password manager.
4. Review **Signed-in devices** if you suspect another device has access.

sections.title: Common profile questions
sections.body: Changing your personal email is different from changing the business’s public email. A new account email needs verification before verified areas can be used. The email must not already belong to another account. If you normally use Google and do not know a current password, use the account recovery process rather than guessing repeatedly.
